svg.aria-label: Visor drive: slide, tilt and locking
svg.text: Visor drive: slide, tilt and locking
The windscreen visor panel (PV5) slides out on two rails and tilts to 20°. One button at the rear panel; every motion is interlocked.
Visor drive: slide, tilt and locking
Generated by tools/wiring/diagram.py from cad/fitout/wiring.py — cable IDs and lengths
match bom/cable-schedule-v0.14.csv. Measurements still [EST] until confirmed on the vehicle.
230 V work: licensed electrician only (AS/NZS 3000 · AS/NZS 3001.2). Not certified.
LEGEND · line weight ∝ conductor size · ID · size tags = cable schedule IDs · purple ▶◀ = detachable connector · yellow flags = continues on another sheet

g.text: fuses: M2 15 A, M3/M4 7.5 A each,
M2 shaft end and both tilt drives

svg.text: PVV → MC4 at U11 → PVS → QP3 → U13
S3 at the rear panel, sheet E6
S3 switches DEP / STOW to ground;
IP67 roller-lever switches, NO; B4 is set 1° before the hard stop
high-flex, runs in an igus chain beside the left rail
check IGN off, B1 + B3 closed
Y1/Y2 on, M2 starts; Y1/Y2 off once B1 opens
M3 + M4 tilt down until B3
M2 retracts to B1; pins spring into ramped strikers
M3 + M4 tilt up to 20°, B4 = limit
latches need no power to lock
worms hold the panel, nothing powered
No deploy with the ignition on. Engine on while not stowed →
BZ1 sounds, LED flashes; nothing moves without the button.
M2 runs only with B3 closed: the panel slides flat, then tilts.
Over-current on any channel → stop and back off 2 mm (pinch).
Mechanical stop at 22° keeps ≥ 87 mm to the glass even if
B4 fails; worm drives cannot be back-driven by wind or load.
Latches fail locked. Stow when gusts exceed ~40 km/h.
Y1/Y2 are short-duty (≈5 s): energised < 3 s per deploy.
U11 draws < 20 mA idle; isolate with FB1 way 10.
